about_the_game:
Single-Character Deep Cultivation, the Ultimate Immersive Experience!

Are you, like us, tired of a screen full of 3-star, 4-star, and 5-star character cards? Tired of equipping and assigning skills for every member of your squad? Tired of most companions only being around for a short while?

A single character is the soul of an idle game!

Only a single character can deliver true immersion!

Dozens of attributes + Dozens of skills = Endless build possibilities!

Forge your one-of-a-kind character and write your own legend!

An Equipment System So Vast It's Maddening!

Cloth, Leather, Mail, Plate armor; Blades, Spears, Swords, Halberds, Staves, Shields, Bows, Crossbows, Jewelry, Wings, Pets—we have it all!

Whether you're a fearless warrior clad in heavy armor or a seemingly "frail" mystic mage, our massive armory has something perfect for you!

Equipment comes in common tiers like Common, Uncommon, and Rare, with unique Epic and Legendary gear waiting to be discovered!

Gear That Glows, Power That Shows!

Should you only see the difference between Legendary and Common gear when checking stats?

Does enhancing to +13 just mean cold, hard number increases?

Absolutely not!

In AFKandia, powerful gear comes with visual impact! True golden Legendaries shimmer with a golden light, making you the most dazzling presence in the crowd!

Battle Strategy: Show Off Your Skills, Even While Idle!

Who says idle games lack strategy?

In AFKandia, you can set precise conditions for skill activation:

        When there are more than 5 monsters on the field?

        When your own HP falls below 30%?

        Cast every 5 seconds?

Unleash your tactical brilliance!
